summary: Single-shot greedy baseline on stock FM
hypothesis: A plain single-shot greedy call on the stock FM can reliably extract actionable tasks from a ramble. This sets the floor: we expect it to handle clear extraction cases well but fail on edge cases like zero-task rambles and retractions.
technique: A single greedy on-device call on the stock base FM with no retrieval, schema guidance, or post-processing — a minimal single-shot extract pipeline used as the seed baseline.
result: Achieved quality 0.818 on dev-11 (W/T/L vs Sonnet = 0/8/1), with perfect rubric scores across all five axes (faith=5, atom=5, action=5, cover=5, nonRed=5) and specPass=100%. Hypothesis partially confirmed: extraction cases scored ~1.0, but the entire quality gap traces to 4 zero-task failures and one retraction miss; KEPT as new best (seed baseline).
label: baseline
